title: HCS Miner Batch Upload v1
description: Batch upload of events from miner to HSCL1 receiver. Events are idempotent by event_id and ordered by sequence.

boot_id.description: Boot identifier matching events in this batch

sequence_start.description: Inclusive start sequence number of events in this batch

sequence_end.description: Inclusive end sequence number of events in this batch

batch_id.description: SHA-256 of (device_id + boot_id + sequence_start + sequence_end + events canonical JSON), truncated to 32 hex chars. Used for idempotent batch deduplication.

events.description: Array of event envelopes (hcs.miner.event.v1). All events must share the same device_id and boot_id.

body_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical events array JSON

signature.description: HMAC-SHA-256 of (method + path + timestamp + batch_id + body_sha256) using per-device key (32 bytes = 64 hex chars)
